maya: Kicking off mini canary for rwd-infer v2.6.0 -> 8% (EU). Change window until 20:30 UTC. Watch: eu-west 5xx, tokenizer regressions, p95. Stop if eu 5xx >0.6% for 5m or p95 +120ms for 5m. Ack pls.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout job=job-8811 target=8% version=v2.6.0 regions=[eu] dashboard=https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/job-8811 actions: /deploy pause job-8811 | /deploy rollback job-8811 --to v2.5.9

jordan: saw eu-west 500s tick to 0.58% 90s ago, tokenizer WARNs in a couple spans. not over threshold yet.

sam: tailing logs and running smoke prompts against canary. will report in 5m.

maya: pausing auto-escalation. holding further ramp until we confirm. /deploy pause job-8811

deploy-bot: job-8811 paused by maya (manual hold). traffic locked at 8%. rollback cmd cached.

sre-team: infra healthy, p95 +18ms. error-rate correlates with tokenizer WARNs but not sustained. recommend hold and observe 10m.

jordan: opened hotfix PR to pin tokenizer in staged cohorts: https://git.redwood/infer/PR-1702. includes smoke checks.

maya: ops note added and release notes updated to mention the canary hold and rollback playbook. if threshold breaches we'll rollback to v2.5.9 and pin tokenizer. Acks?

sam: ack  monitoring and smoke tests on deck.

jordan: ack  ready to merge PR and trigger rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: snapshot: eu 5xx=0.57%, p95 delta=+17ms. paused. awaiting manual resume/rollback.
